SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN MEMBERSHIP_GRADE MG ON M.member_id = MG.member_id
AND ( M.member_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR M.login_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR M.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND MG.grade_name = #{searchGrade}
AND M.status = #{searchStatus}
AND M.created_at >= CURDATE() AND M.created_at < CURDATE () + INTERVAL 1 DAY
AND M.created_at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 6 DAY AND M.created_at < CURDATE () + INTERVAL 1 DAY
AND M.created_at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 29 DAY AND M.created_at < CURDATE () + INTERVAL 1 DAY

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount,
SUM( CASE WHEN created_at >= CURDATE() AND created_at < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS todayCount,
SUM( CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS activeCount,
SUM( CASE WHEN status = 'INACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS dormantCount,
SUM( CASE WHEN status = 'WITHDRAWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS withdrawnCount
FROM MEMBER

SELECT M.*, MG.grade_name AS memberGrade, COALESCE(O.total_payment, 0) AS totalPayment, COALESCE(O.order_count, 0) AS orderCount
FROM MEMBER M
LEFT JOIN MEMBERSHIP_GRADE MG ON M.member_id = MG.member_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT member_id, SUM(final_amount) AS total_payment, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ORDERS GROUP BY member_id ) O ON M.member_id = O.member_id
WHERE M.member_id = #{memberId}

UPDATE MEMBER
SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW()
WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status != 'WITHDRAWN'

UPDATE MEMBER
SET status = 'WITHDRAWN', withdrawn_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status != 'WITHDRAWN'
